svg.title: OpenDrive Stack
svg.desc: A small vehicle laps a track while LiDAR returns light up nearby walls and YOLO detections appear; the drive arbiter log switches manual, auto and prompt modes, then an e-stop halts the car.
svg.text: A ROS 2 workspace that turns a small Ackermann
car into a product: one installer, one CLI,
and a browser dashboard to drive it.
System manager: launch, health, GPU, systemd
40 Hz drive arbiter: e-stop first, watchdogs
YOLOv8 perception; LLM prompt driving next
